item.name: Huddlestock Fintech AS
item.description: Norwegian listed company, based in Stavanger. On 18 November 2026 it signed a letter of intent with Firi for a tied-agent solution, according to its MFN stock-exchange notice; the collaboration is conditional on further commercial, operational and regulatory assessment and is not a completed agreement.

sources.title: Huddlestock has signed a letter of intent (LOI) with Firi
